title: Broken checkout in new API deploy
reason: The engineer correctly identified the API as the faulty component, the bug introduced in version 2.3.2, and the upgrade/deploy as the trigger.
root_cause: The API container was upgraded to version 2.3.2, which contains a bug where a variable expected to be a string is None, causing a 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip' error on order POST requests.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced a regression in the order creation logic: a missing null check on the payment_token field causes an unhandled AttributeError on POST /api/orders, while read endpoints like /api/products still work.
